title: Chapter 143: Inspecting The Carpentry Workshop
content:
Chapter 143: Inspecting The Carpentry Workshop

The next day, Wang Shuo did not follow Ayub to earn military merit points.

Because the city wall must be built today, Hadro should send him bricks for the city wall this morning.

Walking on the newly built main street, all the construction sites are busy.

As the loyalty has increased, everyone works very hard.

Wang Shuo walked to the door of the woodworking workshop and saw four or five people inside, tinkering with some wood.

"Who is in charge here?" Wang Shuo walked in and walked around a pedestal.

"Lord, why are you here!"

The surrounding people looked up at Wang Shuo, and a thinly dressed strong man came over and wiped the sweat from his forehead.

This person was Xu Minzhong, the person in charge of the woodworking workshop.

The huge room was filled with the smell of wood dust and the noisy sound of sawing wood.

"Well, just take a look. Are you making a catapult?"

Seeing that the others did not wear any protective gear to protect their mouths and noses.

Wang Shuo couldn't cover his mouth and nose, so he had to bite the bullet and raise his voice.

"Yes, Lord, the technology of the catapult is very complicated. We haven't fully studied it yet. We can only try it first. Mr. Matar will come over later and study with us."

"Okay, study it well. Wana Village will not forget your efforts." Wang Shuo nodded to Xu Minzhong and said affirmatively.

"Yes, Lord."

After Wang Shuo left the carpentry workshop, he thought that the treatment of the people in the territory should be solved as soon as possible.

At this time, Xiao Laoteng found Wang Shuo and asked when the masons would learn to draw defensive runes.

Wang Shuo saw the anxious look on his face and smiled knowingly.

He said calmly: "Master Architect, don't worry, you see, there are still big gaps in our city wall bricks now. We must hurry up to make them. In addition, it takes time to build the wall, so..."

"I can help build the wall."

I'm just waiting for you to say this!

The construction speed of an intermediate architect is totally incomparable to that of a low-level bricklayer.

"Thank you very much!" Wang Shuo smiled, "Someone will send a batch of wall bricks later. When the time comes, I will trouble the architect."

Xiao Laoteng was shocked. This lord is really capable.

As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Shuo felt the movement of Hadro teleporting.

In Wang Shuo's territory, anyone who does not belong to Wana Village will be prompted when entering the village.

Moreover, Wang Shuo has given Hadro the permission to teleport. He only needs to connect to Wang Shuo's portal address and get his permission.

"Excuse me!"

After Wang Shuo finished speaking, he walked towards the portal.

The moment he saw Hadro, Wang Shuo felt relieved. Now his black iron wall finally has the hope of being completed today.

"Lord, lord, sir, after I went back, I immediately went around to buy things, and finally, I got them all together." Hadro was out of breath, looking out of breath.

"Thank you for your hard work! Let's go, have some tea first." Wang Shuo led Hadro to the lord's mansion.

Hadro drank a sip of tea, took a break, and directly took out a few backpacks and handed them to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo checked them and showed a satisfied look.

"Not bad." Wang Shuo laughed and directly handed the energy crystal to the other party.

[Black Iron-level wall bricks +30w, energy crystals -24,000. ]

After getting the bricks, Wang Shuo quickly asked someone to hand them over to Yan Fujie and asked him to find Xiao Laoteng to be responsible for the construction.

He didn't dare to refuse the things that had been agreed before, after all, he still had more than 100,000 gold coins that had not been delivered to him.
